_comment: REVIEWED allowlist of unauthenticated (auth=open) HTTP routes — the ONLY
routes permitted to serve without a token when ANCHOR_TOKEN is configured.
Default-deny by construction: route_table.py declares token as the default;
a route may be 'open' ONLY if it appears here with a justification. The gate
(method, pattern) set equals route_table.open_route_keys() EXACTLY — adding an
'open' route to the table fails the build until this reviewed file is edited.
The data-plane rows tagged 'W8/W9' are scheduled to move open -> token under
the warn-then-enforce soak; when they flip, delete their entry here.
